tags: @guarantee ok.origin-default without `origin`, sets "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" to "*"
@guarantee ok.origin-string with a string `origin`, sets "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" to it
@guarantee ok.origin-list with an array `origin`, sets "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" to the request origin when the array contains it
@guarantee ok.origin-function with a function `origin`, sets "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" to what it returns for the request origin
@guarantee ok.methods-default without `allowMethods`, a preflight gets "Access-Control-Allow-Methods" listing "GET", "HEAD", "PUT", "POST", "DELETE", "PATCH" and "QUERY"
@guarantee ok.methods with `allowMethods` (an array, or a function of the origin), a preflight gets "Access-Control-Allow-Methods" listing those methods
@guarantee ok.headers with `allowHeaders`, a preflight gets "Access-Control-Allow-Headers" listing them; the default list is empty
@guarantee ok.max-age with `maxAge`, a preflight gets "Access-Control-Max-Age" set to it
@guarantee ok.credentials with `credentials` true, sets "Access-Control-Allow-Credentials"
@guarantee ok.expose with `exposeHeaders`, sets "Access-Control-Expose-Headers" listing them; the default list is empty

@guarantee ok.defaults with no options, sets "Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy" "same-origin", "Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy" "same-origin", "Origin-Agent-Cluster" "?1", "Referrer-Policy" "no-referrer", "Strict-Transport-Security" "max-age=15552000; includeSubDomains", "X-Content-Type-Options" "nosniff", "X-DNS-Prefetch-Control" "off", "X-Download-Options" "noopen", "X-Frame-Options" "SAMEORIGIN", "X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies" "none" and "X-XSS-Protection" "0"
@guarantee ok.powered-by removes the "X-Powered-By" header
@guarantee ok.coep-off "Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy" is not set by default; with `crossOriginEmbedderPolicy` true it is "require-corp"
@guarantee ok.disable an option set to false leaves its header out
@guarantee ok.override an option set to a string sets its header to that string
@guarantee ok.csp with `contentSecurityPolicy`, sets "Content-Security-Policy" from the directives, each camelCase directive written in kebab case with its values separated by spaces
@guarantee ok.csp-report-only with `contentSecurityPolicyReportOnly`, sets "Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only" the same way
@guarantee ok.reporting with `reportingEndpoints`, sets "Reporting-Endpoints"; with `reportTo`, sets "Report-To"
@guarantee ok.permissions with `permissionsPolicy`, sets "Permissions-Policy"
@guarantee ok.nonce a directive holding `NONCE` gets a nonce value, and the same nonce is available as `secureHeadersNonce` on the context
@guarantee ok.value returns a CSP source of the form "'nonce-<value>'" and stores the value as `secureHeadersNonce` on the context
@guarantee ok.content-length when the request has a "Content-Length" header larger than `maxSize`, calls `onError` without reading the body
@guarantee ok.stream without "Content-Length", reads the body as a stream and calls `onError` once more than `maxSize` bytes were read
@guarantee ok.pass a body of at most `maxSize` bytes reaches the handler unchanged
@guarantee ok.generate sets `requestId` on the context to a new id from `generator`, by default `crypto.randomUUID()`
@guarantee ok.header-in when the request has the header `headerName` (default "X-Request-Id"), uses its value instead of generating one
@guarantee ok.header-off with `headerName` "", the request header is ignored
@guarantee ok.limit a request id longer than `limitLength` (default 255) is not used
